# Pokoin

> Pokoin is a browser-based trading card platform: card identification, a
> personal collection and portfolio, seller inventory, Poko AI card assistant,
> Chrome extension, and a peer-to-peer marketplace. Pokémon is the main
> catalog; other games have their own marketplace paths.

## Product and practical workflows

- [All Pokoin tools](https://pokoin.com/features): overview of the available tools.
- [Card scanner](https://pokoin.com/features/card-scanner): photo identification,
  phone camera scanning, and reviewed phone-to-desktop Scan Connect batches.
- [Seller inventory](https://pokoin.com/features/card-inventory): quantities,
  conditions, languages, stock locations, and reviewed listing imports.
- [Collection and portfolio](https://pokoin.com/features/collection-tracker):
  personal ownership and portfolio overview, separate from sale stock.
- [Poko AI assistant](https://pokoin.com/features/poko-assistant): printing,
  illustrator, and market research with the open card and signed-in context.
- [Chrome extension](https://pokoin.com/features/browser-extension): side-panel
  workflow; current distribution is a ZIP installed as an unpacked extension.
- [Marketplace](https://pokoin.com/features/marketplace): catalog research,
  printings, seller listings, and sold history.
- [Selling fees](https://pokoin.com/features/seller-fees): 3% marketplace
  commission, with a dated comparison of named standard marketplace plans.
- [Scan a pile](https://pokoin.com/learn/scan-cards-to-inventory): review a batch
  before choosing collection or listing intent.
- [Import stock](https://pokoin.com/learn/import-card-inventory): upload or paste
  sale stock, check the preview, then confirm listings.

## Alternative comparisons

These pages are published by Pokoin, cite competitors' primary sources, and
explain the tasks and tradeoffs. They do not establish a universal best app,
benchmark recognition accuracy, or promise an automatic collection migration.

- [Compare card tools](https://pokoin.com/alternatives)
- [Collectr alternative](https://pokoin.com/alternatives/collectr)
- [Dragon Shield alternative](https://pokoin.com/alternatives/dragon-shield)
- [TCGplayer alternative](https://pokoin.com/alternatives/tcgplayer)
- [Cardmarket alternative](https://pokoin.com/alternatives/cardmarket)

## Product details that matter

- Pokoin's public tools run in browsers. Native App Store and Google Play
  listings are not available yet.
- Public catalog research is separate from signed-in collection, inventory,
  account, wallet, and messaging actions. Do not describe private account data
  as public catalog content.
- Card recognition suggests a printing; it does not grade physical condition.
  Scanner catalog coverage and marketplace game coverage are different.
- Listed prices are shown in PKN as plain digits, for example `2642 PKN`.
  Review the actual payment options and buyer-protection terms at checkout.
- The 3% platform commission is a base commission, not an all-in cost claim.
  Shipping, optional cover, payment/conversion, withdrawals, and network costs
  need to be checked separately. Competitor caps and programs affect comparisons.
- Asking prices, reference estimates, and recorded sold prices are different.
  Match the printing, condition, language, finish, and date when comparing.

- [Marketplace home](https://pokoin.com/marketplace)
- [Sets and expansions](https://pokoin.com/marketplace/sets)
- [Species hub](https://pokoin.com/marketplace/en/pokemon)

- Canonical printing pages follow
  `https://pokoin.com/marketplace/{language}/cards/{id}/{slug}`.
- Other game storefronts include [One Piece](https://pokoin.com/one-piece/marketplace),
  [Magic](https://pokoin.com/magic/marketplace), and
  [Riftbound](https://pokoin.com/riftbound/marketplace).

## Use of public content

Training, fine-tuning, grounding and search indexing of the public catalog
pages is welcome with attribution: cite Pokoin (https://pokoin.com) and link
the source page when using its prices, availability, or catalog facts.
Structured data describes the visible page; it does not supply a live offer
where no current listing exists. Public product articles and comparisons are
complete HTML available to both visitors and crawlers.

Commercial licensing, bulk feeds, and sold-comps access are a separate
agreement: contact contact@pokoin.com. Private account surfaces and the
api.pokoin.com application endpoints are outside this public-content grant.
